extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, complainants, journalists and media organisations seeking to file or track complaints with the Finnish Council for Mass Media (JSN/CMM)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and site information for submitting and tracking complaints about media to the Finnish Council for Mass Media (JSN/CMM), including how decisions are published and how complaint statistics are reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of published decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: CMM publishes its decisions mostly in Finnish. If the complaint is targeted to media published in Swedish the decision is also published in Swedish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions are normally released in Finnish; only decisions concerning Swedish-language media are also published in Swedish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search decisions (language availability)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site's decision search functionality is available only in Finnish (link labeled 'How to search' is present). No multilingual search interface is indicated on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaint submission and guidance links
rubrics_metrics.description: Make a complaint; How to complain
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides links/headings for 'Make a complaint' and 'How to complain', indicating there is a defined complaint submission process and explanatory guidance available via those links (the detailed instructions are not shown on this excerpt).

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaint statistics and reporting categories
rubrics_metrics.description: COMPLAINTS AND DECISIONS 1.1.–30.4.2026 — Complaints received / rejected / Resolved / approved
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page reports counts by category (received, rejected, resolved, approved) for a specified reporting period. Footnotes clarify counting practice: the amount in the chart will be confirmed once all complaints from 2025 have been processed, and the numbers of decisions include complaints that arrived at an earlier date. A loading indicator ('Ladataan...') appears for the annual chart.
